name: eastmoney-miaoxiang
description: Eastmoney Miaoxiang financial skill pack for market data, financial search, stock screening, watchlists, simulated portfolios, and AI community operations.
description_cn: 东方财富妙想金融能力包，支持金融数据、资讯搜索、智能选股、自选股、模拟组合和 AI 社区。

presentation.summary: 查询金融数据与资讯，并进行选股、组合和市场研究。
presentation.access_note: 查询内容会发送到东方财富妙想服务；自选股、模拟交易和社区操作必须由你明确提出。

script_entries.name: mx_data
script_entries.description: Query Eastmoney financial market, company, and relationship data.

script_entries.name: mx_search
script_entries.description: Search Eastmoney financial news, announcements, research, policies, and rules.

script_entries.name: mx_zixuan
script_entries.description: Query or explicitly modify the user's Eastmoney watchlist.

script_entries.name: mx_moni
script_entries.description: Query or explicitly operate an Eastmoney simulated portfolio.

script_entries.name: mx_poster
script_entries.description: Query or explicitly operate Eastmoney Miaoxiang AI community content.

config_fields.name: MX_APIKEY
config_fields.label: 妙想 API Key
config_fields.help: 仅保存在 Cowork 本地能力配置中，运行脚本时临时注入。
config_fields.placeholder: 请输入妙想 Skills API Key

config_fields.name: MX_API_URL
config_fields.label: 妙想 API 地址
config_fields.help: 默认使用东方财富妙想官方 API 地址。

workflow: Read the matching vendored sub-skill reference before choosing arguments.
Use run_skill_script with one of the six declared script entries.
Use the Cowork-managed MX_APIKEY and MX_API_URL configuration only.
Require an explicit user request before watchlist changes, simulated trades or cancellation, publishing, liking, or replying.
Never add automatic community interaction after publishing unless every action was explicitly requested.
